searchText: OK I have a state expiry proto-EIP https://notes.ethereum.org/@vbuterin/state_expiry_eip It's pretty epic and complicated including its dependencies (Verkle trees, the new tree key scheme, and 32 byte addresses), but it at least attempts to be (mostly) fully specified Hi all how about a call next friday on presentation and initial discussion for above eip? Would 3pm utc work, or needs to be 2pm? (Thurs has merge and eth2; and fri gives more time for people to read eip) Polling: Fri june 11 3pm UTC Or 2pm UTC Or the week after?
